summary.text: In the desert city of Naktamun on Amonkhet, the Gatewatch arrives to find and stop Nicol Bolas, and finds a world where he has corrupted the gods and engineered the Trials so that inhabitants reach perfection before killing each other, to create an army of Eternals.
Gideon pledges himself to Oketra, while the doubter Samut realizes that the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser who caused the plane's calamity and is imprisoned as a dissenter.
The Gatewatch frees Samut and they all fight in the final Trial, but when Bolas returns in the Hour of Devastation he kills most of the gods and soundly defeats the planeswalkers, scattering them.
